mapper.select: SELECT cddrl.req_ln_id, cddrl.req_hd_id, cddrl.cashflow_id, nvl(cddrl.surplus_amount,0) as surplus_amount, nvl(cddrl.surplus_principal,0) as surplus_principal, nvl(cddrl.surplus_interest,0) as surplus_interest, nvl(cddrl.write_off_due_amount,0) as write_off_due_amount, nvl(cddrl.write_off_principal,0) as write_off_principal, nvl(cddrl.write_off_interest,0) as write_off_interest, cddrl.object_version_number, cddrl.request_id, cddrl.program_id, cddrl.created_by, cddrl.creation_date, cddrl.last_updated_by, cddrl.last_update_date, cddrl.last_update_login, cc.contract_id, cc.contract_number, ccc.times, hbm.bp_name, ccc.due_date, nvl(ccc.due_amount,0) as due_amount, nvl(ccc.received_amount,0) as received_amount, ccc.cf_item, hci.description cf_item_n, ccc.cf_type, cddrl.source_info_id, cddrl.info_id_batch FROM csh_deposit_deduct_req_ln cddrl, con_contract_cashflow ccc, con_contract cc, hls_bp_master hbm, hls_cashflow_item hci WHERE ccc.cashflow_id = cddrl.cashflow_id AND cc.contract_id = ccc.contract_id AND hbm.bp_id = cc.tenant_id AND hci.cf_item = ccc.cf_item AND cddrl.req_hd_id = #{reqHdId} ORDER BY cddrl.req_ln_id

SELECT nvl(MAX(ccc.times), -1) FROM con_contract_cashflow ccc, csh_deposit_deduct_req_hd cddrh, csh_transaction ct WHERE ct.transaction_id = cddrh.transaction_id AND ccc.contract_id = ct.contract_id AND ccc.cf_direction = 'INFLOW' AND ccc.write_off_flag != 'FULL' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM csh_deposit_deduct_req_ln cddrl WHERE cddrl.cashflow_id = ccc.cashflow_id AND cddrl.req_hd_id = cddrh.req_hd_id) AND cddrh.req_hd_id = #{reqHdId}
SELECT t.REQ_LN_ID from csh_deposit_deduct_req_ln t where t.req_hd_id = #{reqHdId}
